## Description

Formulates stock universe cointegration network partitioning into Maximum Cut (Max-Cut) QUBO problems solved via quantum annealers to identify robust market-neutral trading clusters.

## Where it may fit

Large equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 1000), statistical arbitrage cluster selection during macro turbulence.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday return matrices, cointegration test statistics, correlation adjacency matrices.

## Caveats

Qubit embedding heuristics required on NISQ hardware for large sparse graph structures.
